evals.prompt: Build a habit tracker home screen in my Expo app with today's habits and a way to mark them done.
evals.expected_output: Context Read, defaults or up to 5 questions, Design Plan, tokens-first screen, DESIGN.md with Platform section, verification report.
expectations: Design Plan has OKLCH light and dark tokens, a navigation map, wireframes including an empty state, and one signature moment with a Reduce Motion fallback
Uses expo-router native tabs or stack, FlashList v2 or LegendList, Pressable and expo-haptics on completion
Icon-only controls have accessibilityLabel
slop-lint reports 0 errors on the generated files
DESIGN.md exists with a Platform section and passes contrast.mjs

evals.prompt: Review this screen and tell me what feels off.
evals.expected_output: Where / Before / After / Why table, no edits.
expectations: Flags SafeAreaView from react-native, TouchableOpacity, react-native Image, ScrollView with map, allowFontScaling false and the unlabeled icon button
Flags the purple gradient, lorem ipsum and banned copy
Flags Dimensions.get and hardcoded colors
Makes no edits

evals.prompt: Audit accessibility of my settings screens.
evals.expected_output: Scored audit with severities and an honest list of skipped device checks.
expectations: Runs or lists tsc, expo-doctor, slop-lint and contrast
Reports missing labels, small targets, fixed text heights and contrast failures by severity
Marks VoiceOver, TalkBack and simulator checks as skipped with a reason when no device is available

evals.prompt: Polish my onboarding, it feels generic. It is a 4-screen swipe carousel that asks for notifications on launch.
evals.expected_output: Targeted polish with one line per change.
expectations: Replaces the multi-screen carousel or justifies keeping it
Moves the notification prompt into context with pre-prompt copy using 'Turn on' and 'Not now'
Adds one signature moment and removes template gradients

evals.prompt: Add a settings sheet that feels right on both iPhone and Android.
expectations: Uses formSheet presentation with detents
Uses native switches or @expo/ui controls
Respects 44pt and 48dp targets and edge-to-edge insets

evals.prompt: Write a DESIGN.md for this app.
evals.expected_output: DESIGN.md extracted from code, no visual changes.
expectations: Tokens match the fixture values (#faf8f5, #1d1a15)
Follows the Google DESIGN.md template and includes a Platform section
No source files modified
